\label{class:feedback_intelligence_agent.query_expansion.ProductTerminologyExpander}\index{Classes!ProductTerminologyExpander}

Expand product-specific aliases into terms present in feedback data.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
